summary: The `db/seed.ts` fix itself was already correct and committed; the only gap was the missing documentation of manual end-to-end verification. I re-ran both scenarios for real (the failure path hit a genuine live 500 from the Pokemon TCG API, confirmed via direct curl; the success path used a local mock server since the live API was down), confirmed exit codes 1 and 0 respectively with `echo $?`, cleaned up all test artifacts and mock data from the real database, and added a "Manual verification" section to `docs/tickets/seed-script-silent-failure.md` documenting both runs in lieu of an automated test. — researched from the venture's brain (semantic), planned as a PRP with 4 validation gate(s) (written), then passed on round 2 of 2 (earlier rounds failed — round 1: validation gates not met — coverage: manually run both the zero-card failure scenario and the normal success scenario end-to-end and confirm exit codes with `echo $?`, since `db/seed.ts` has no existing automated test harness (unlike `src/lib/*.test.ts`) and hits a live external API — note this manual verification in the PR description in lieu of an automated test. (no PR description or doc anywhere in the diff/state notes the required manual end-to-end verification of both scenarios — only a one-line implementer summary in impl-1.log exists)) against them plus tests, /review review pass (0 critical) and /qa: Change is confined to db/seed.ts, a standalone CLI script (bun run db:seed) with no web UI or API route surface — nothing to QA in a browser. No frontend/backend server behavior changed. Ticket doc already records manual verification of both the failure path (exit 1, no false success message) and success path (exit 0) against the live and a mock API..
